rules.statement: The court held that there was no valid partition decree allotting the southern seven-eighths of the land to defendants' vendors, and thus plaintiffs were not estopped from asserting their title.
rules.supporting_quote: "In spite of respondents' objection, I think it was open to plaintiffs to take this point. They were not parties to the decree and had no notice of it, and therefore their averring that defendants claimed under a decree and praying that it be set aside as obtained by fraud does not preclude them from taking exception to the contents of the decree when the record was produced and relied upon."
